items.exampleEn: Please call me back as soon as possible.
It will take at least two hours to get there.
items.exampleZh: 到那裡至少要花兩個小時。

items.exampleEn: I didn't like living in the city at first.
items.exampleZh: 起初，我不喜歡住在城市裡。

items.exampleEn: I took your umbrella by mistake.
items.exampleZh: 我不小心拿了你的雨傘。

items.exampleEn: By the way, have you seen my keys?
items.exampleZh: 對了，你有看到我的鑰匙嗎？

items.exampleEn: Her dream of becoming a pilot came true.
items.exampleZh: 她當飛行員的夢想實現了。

items.exampleEn: The team did their best, but they still lost.
items.exampleZh: 球隊盡力了，但還是輸了。

items.sentenceEn: My brother deleted all my photos by mistake.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟不小心把我的照片全刪了。

items.audioEn: The train is late again. We have waited at least thirty minutes.
items.audioZh: 火車又誤點了，我們已經等了至少三十分鐘。
options: About an hour and a half

items.sentenceEn: I'll reply to your email as soon as possible.
items.sentenceZh: 我會盡快回覆你的電子郵件。

items.sentenceEn: At first the work was hard, but now I enjoy it.
items.sentenceZh: 起初這份工作很辛苦，但現在我很喜歡。

items.stemEn: I didn't mean to break your cup. I did it ____.
items.stemZh: 我不是故意打破你的杯子，我是不小心的。

items.stemEn: The exam is very important, so please ____.
items.stemZh: 這場考試很重要，所以請盡力。

items.passageEn: Mia has wanted to be a nurse since she was a child. At first, her parents were worried because the job is hard. But Mia studied at least three hours every night and always did her best. Last month, a hospital in her hometown offered her a job. She sent her parents a message: "Call me as soon as possible! I have good news." When they called, her mother cried with joy. "By the way," Mia said near the end of the call, "I start next Monday, so I need new shoes!"
items.passageZh: Mia 從小就想當護理師。起初，她的父母很擔心，因為這份工作很辛苦。但 Mia 每天晚上至少讀三個小時的書，而且總是盡全力。上個月，她家鄉的一家醫院給了她一份工作。她傳訊息給父母：「盡快打給我！我有好消息。」他們打來時，她媽媽高興得哭了。快講完電話時，Mia 說：「對了，我下週一開始上班，所以我需要新鞋子！」

questions.questionZh: Mia 的父母起初為什麼擔心？
Mia 在電話最後說了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這個房間至少可以坐二十個人。
referenceEn: At least twenty people can sit in this room.
This room has seats for at least twenty people.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 at least twenty 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 twenty or more 等）也算對
「可以坐」可寫，例如 can sit in、has seats for、can hold 等

items.promptZh: 我希望你的願望會實現。
referenceEn: I hope your wish will come true.
I hope your wish comes true.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 will come true、comes true 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 I hope you get your wish 等）也算對
I hope 後面的子句可用未來式或現在式（例如 will come true、comes true 等）
